title: Reliable base surfactant
body: We switched our dishwashing liquid to this grade last year. Foam profile is stable and the batches are consistent.

title: Good, watch the viscosity
body: Works well in our all-purpose cleaner. Salt response is a bit stronger than our previous supplier, so adjust the thickener.
Easy to process at room temperature. Documentation for the RSPO claim was complete and quick to get.

title: Stable emulsions in our EC formulation
body: Emulsion stability at 54 degrees for two weeks was fine. Slight creaming at the lowest pH we tested.

title: Does the job
body: Performance is fine but we needed a higher dose than the technical data sheet suggests for our oil phase.

title: Cold process works
body: We dropped the heating step for our body lotion. Saves energy and the texture is the same as before.
Good emulsifier for light lotions. For heavier creams we combine it with a co-emulsifier.

title: Odour issue in our base
body: Preservation efficacy passed the challenge test, but we noticed a faint odour in our fragrance-free base.

title: Passed the challenge test
body: Clean challenge test results at the recommended dose in our surface cleaner. No stability problems after three months.

title: Great for waterborne coatings
body: Good coalescence and low odour. Our applicators noticed the difference on indoor jobs.
Evaporation rate fits our spray application. Price is a bit higher than the alternative we tested.

title: Fine, longer drying time
body: Works, but drying time in cold conditions was longer than expected. We adjusted the blend with a faster solvent.
